snippet.title: Terraria: Spirit Reforged | Sunscorched Update Trailer
snippet.description:
Releases March 28, 2026.

Sunscorched is Spirit Reforged's next major update, which introduces our first boss, Scarabeus, a Desert Expansion, and a new biome! Look forward to new encounters, new weapons, and much more. 

A reminder that this update will be for the latest version of tModLoader, which does not yet support Terraria 1.4.5. 

Spirit Reforged is a remastered version of the best the original Spirit Mod offered and much more. You can look forward to new items, weapons, the Savanna Biome, and World NPCs! Reforged can be played in Singleplayer or Multiplayer.

To learn more, join our Discord: https://discord.gg/013k6H2ufdQjco5kv
